summary: Control Room Direction: the agentic chat as a night-shift mission-control board with ops-board composition, high density everywhere, status-board trace, dark instrument wells with raised composer/interrupt caps, console-tabular voice, motion-as-signal, and the regulated anomaly-first wing as signature.

claims.claim: Control Room Direction carries one thesis through composition, density, typography, color, surfaces, and motion without palette-only divergence
Operations-board composition with status-board trace and anomaly-first wing answers the brief's capable-like-a-control-room perception without breaking session scope or tier disclosure
AA-contrast pairing and reduced-motion fallbacks are load-bearing in the Direction, not appended
Signature anomaly-first wing is regulated so recurrence reads as system rather than tic

decisions.choice: Commit the full Run slate to the Control Room lens for this candidate: ops-board composition, high density everywhere, motion-as-signal, dark instrument wells with raised action caps, console-tabular voice, and the anomaly-first wing as signature
rationale: Territory 2 is the only territory that proves density can be capability rather than clutter, which the brief explicitly demands as capable like a control room
Status-board trace with kind/target/status/duration columns makes the tool-call audit scannable at a glance instead of buried under prose
Anomaly-first wing directly serves trust-but-verify anxiety and vigilance fatigue by spending the operator's attention where it is newest-needed
alternatives: Fall back to a calm reading-column Direction with withdrawn rails
Adopt a ticket-spine model where time is spatial rather than tabular
risks: Dark-ground status color misses AA without disciplined tuning
revisitWhen: Blind critique finds Tier 1 reading drowned by Tier 2 density
AA audit fails on any dark-ground status combination

risks: Tier 1 reading drowns under high-everywhere density unless prose stays capped and the board stays subordinate
Dark-ground amber/red status text fails AA without explicit contrast tuning plus mandatory text-plus-icon pairing
Unregulated pulse and ticking durations reintroduce the vigilance fatigue the board claims to cure
375px drawer semantics and focus management bury evidence if collapse rules are left vague
